name: What is the process for upgrading kitchen lighting with a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for upgrading kitchen lighting with a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, functional needs, and budget. Our team will assess your current kitchen layout and electrical infrastructure. We then provide design recommendations and a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, and timeline. Once approved, we handle all aspects of the installation, including electrical wiring, fixture placement, and finishing touches. We ensure minimal disruption to your home and adhere to local building codes, concluding with a final walk-through to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, assessment, design, proposal, installation, and a final walk-through, handled by the contractor.
